description: This file defines the Zend_Registry class, a core component of the Zend Framework used for managing global data storage and singleton registry instances.

classes.name: Zend_Registry
classes.description: A singleton class for managing global registry data, providing methods to get, set, and check registration of shared objects.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the default singleton instance of Zend_Registry.

methods.name: setInstance
methods.description: Sets the singleton instance of Zend_Registry to a specified object.

methods.name: setClassName
methods.description: Sets the class name to be used for the registry instance, allowing for subclassing.

methods.name: _unsetInstance
methods.description: Unsets the singleton registry instance, mainly for testing purposes.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the registry by key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in the registry under a specified key.

methods.name: isRegistered
methods.description: Checks if a key is registered in the registry.

methods.name: offsetExists
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the registry array.
